run_covisibility_cli: run the covisibility script to compute pairwise covisibility for all scenes in a dataset root
compute_covisibility_function: compute pairwise covisibility scores between all frame pairs for a single scene using depth reprojection
compute_frustum_intersection: compute frustum intersection to pre-filter view pairs likely to overlap before expensive reprojection
project_points_to_views: project 3D world points from one view into the image planes of other overlapping views
sample_depths_at_reprojections: sample depth values at reprojected pixel locations to validate depth consistency across views
